method: compose the minimum official DSH plugin set in a bare Cordis context over a TEST-OWNED temp session root, create ONE agent with agents.create(), read the identity from the returned handle, then dispose. agent.followup() is NEVER called.
expectedInvariant: a real first-party Session is created and its identity is readable from the handle, with NO model turn and NO provider request

noModelProof.sourceLevelExclusionGuarantee: agent.followup() is the only call that creates a turn; the script never calls it, so no turn exists to dispatch a request

runtimeMeasurement.observationPoint: the llm/stream Cordis waterfall that LlmRuntime.streamWithRegistration routes every model request through
runtimeMeasurement.sessionSeqInterpretation: a model turn appends turn/start, request/header and related events; seq === 0 after a successful create therefore shows that NO turn was appended

testProfileProvenance: a bare Cordis context created by the script itself over a mkdtemp session root; no user DSH profile is loaded, no personal session directory is read
identityAgreement: the created identity is the id DSH published for the session; AgentRegistry.enter refuses any agent whose id disagrees with its session id
remainingUncertainty: this establishes first-party Session CREATION, not the full Host -> Parent route (that is the Level C gate)
the session is disposed immediately, so durability of this artifact is not claimed
